verdict.rationale: First-party docs name Apple MLX as one of LM Studio's inference engines, and GPU offload is configurable via `lms load --gpu`. A community user calls it one of the most efficient ways to run LLMs on Apple Silicon now that it supports MLX. One brief hands-on report found it much slower than Ollama on an M1, which questions relative speed but does not show acceleration failing. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of Metal or native ARM builds, Apple Silicon performance details or benchmarks, and consistent independent speed corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: LM Studio has quickly become the best way to run local LLMs on an Apple Silicon Mac... Now that LM Studio supports MLX models, it's one of the most efficient too.
